mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an addition or remodel a kitchen in Pasadena?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of building an addition or remodeling a kitchen in Pasadena can vary greatly, depending on the scope, materials, finishes, and complexity of the design. A standard kitchen remodel might range from $40,000 to $80,000+, while a more luxurious custom kitchen could exceed $100,000. Home additions often start from $75,000 for smaller projects and can easily exceed $200,000 for multi-room expansions. These figures are estimates, and a detailed quote requires a thorough assessment of your specific project plans and selections. We provide transparent, itemized proposals after an initial consultation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for additions or kitchen remodels in Pasadena vary widely based on scope, materials, and design. Kitchen remodels can range from $40,000 to over $100,000, and additions from $75,000 to over $200,000. A detailed quote is provided after consultation.
